# Classroom with weekly quizzes

Simulate a six-week course with one teacher and five students, all AI agents. The course covers three topics: fractions, decimals and percentages. Every week the teacher chooses one topic to teach, and each student chooses whether to study hard or take it easy that week. A student's understanding of a topic grows when it is taught and grows more when they study. At the end of every week there is a quiz on that week's topic, scored from 0 to 10, based on the student's understanding of the topic plus some luck. Students see only their own quiz scores; the teacher sees everyone's. A student's final grade is the average of their quiz scores.

## Deliverables

Report these outputs:
- `quiz_scores` — a map from each student's id to the list of their quiz scores, one per week in order.
- `final_grades` — a map from each student's id to their final grade.
- `class_average` — the average of the final grades.


Build this environment. Save it with write_contract and use the other tools as you see fit. Reply without calling a tool when you are done.
I'll start by exploring the SDK's structure and guides.
I'll probe a few engine features I plan to rely on before writing the real contract.

brief.situation: A {$inputs.weeks}-week course on {$join($inputs.topics, ', ')}. One teacher, {$count(student)} students, all AI agents. Each week the teacher picks one topic to teach; each student then decides whether to study hard or take it easy; at the end of the week there is a quiz on that topic.
brief.rules: WEEKLY CYCLE. (1) Lesson: the teacher chooses one topic from {$join($inputs.topics, ', ')}. Being taught raises every student's understanding of that topic by {$inputs.teaching_gain}. (2) Study: each student chooses study_hard or take_it_easy. Study hard spends effort points of study energy (each point adds {$inputs.effort_gain} understanding of the topic, on top of the {$inputs.study_gain} every student who studies gains); taking it easy costs nothing and restores {$inputs.rest_gain} energy. Nobody can study a topic before it has been taught this week. (3) Quiz: each student answers a quiz on this week's topic alone. A quiz is scored 0-{$inputs.max_score} from the student's understanding of that topic plus luck of up to +/-{$inputs.luck}, rounded and cut to the 0-{$inputs.max_score} range. A student's final grade is the average of their quiz scores. WHAT YOU SEE. A student sees only their own quiz scores and their own understanding. The teacher sees every student's scores, understanding and energy. Only the teacher chooses topics; only students study and sit quizzes. Understanding carries across weeks, and a topic may be taught again.
